decision: not accepted alone: best fit error so far but corners not reached and focal length unstable within the session; used jointly with 02 (see camera-calibration-joint-02-03.json)
findings: Browser toolbar stayed visible (not true full screen), shrinking the usable top of the screen.
Within each tour round the laptop was still, so all views in a round are coplanar; four rounds give too few board orientations to pin down focal length (halves differ 13%).
Even with the screen filling the view, the board's white border and outer squares keep detected corners ~70 px inside the screen edge.
